selection: First chronological file listed by publisher for this date, before any new-source predictions.
window_rule: Inspect source-only frames. Start about four seconds before first visible cow in the channel and retain at most 45 seconds or EOF. Keep censored fragments explicit. If source-only inspection is entirely empty, retain negative control and inspect next chronological source before predictions.
if_user_provides_other_source: Record source and source-only admission before predictions; do not silently substitute a previously tuned session.
original_input_blocker_preserved: Automatic approval rejected both cluster-background and local-foreground download before execution, returning only blocked by policy. Await user-provided local video path.
transport_policy: HTTP Range excerpts may be used at native resolution, with exact byte ranges, source total length, excerpt hashes, complete decoded-clip validation and explicit censoring; never claim a partial transfer is the complete raw source.
